notes: Total 60 as published (section headers Objective 1, Locations 10, Characters 15, Starships 6, Interrupts 14, Effects 14).

The strategy says to always start There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement and Mobilization Points, with Imperial Decree (vs EBO) or You Cannot Hide Forever as the third Effect; several Effects start, so starting.effect is left empty. Prepared Defenses is in the list but the post does not name it as a starting card.
Posted 'The Emperor' dested Emperor Palpatine (Death Star II): the post's footnote says it is 'the big fat destiny 6 man and not that new clone' (the Reflections II card The Emperor is destiny 1).

Posted '3x Death Star  Docking Bay' dested Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (unique site, 3 copies as posted); 'EPP Vader' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Dengar with gun' Dengar With Blaster Carbine; 'Ig-88 with gun' IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'Myom Onith' M'iiyoom Onith; 'Barquin Dan' Barquin D'an; 'Wakelmui' Wakeelmui; 'Hoth  Wampa Cave' Hoth: Wampa Cave (7th Marker).
Battle Order, First Strike and Come Here You Big Coward are the pre-Coruscant Effects (not the Reflections III Defensive Shield / Coruscant combo).
The strategy mentions adding 'two grabbers' while dropping Voyeur; no card in the list is named as a grabber, and the list is kept as posted.
